subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: Should beta core publication be allowed to complete as `beta-live` while plugin npm and ClawHub convergence continue asynchronously, rather than treating ecosystem convergence as a blocking prerequisite?
rationale: This PR deliberately changes prerelease release readiness and operator recovery semantics; correctness tests cannot decide whether that availability-versus-ecosystem-consistency tradeoff is the intended product policy.

options.title: Approve asynchronous beta convergence
options.body: Allow the beta-live continuation model after restoring the lost QA coverage IDs and documenting its operational ownership.

options.title: Keep beta ecosystem convergence blocking
options.body: Retain the existing blocking beta contract and narrow this PR to non-policy reliability and workflow fixes.

recommendation.title: Approve asynchronous beta convergence
recommendation.body: Allow the beta-live continuation model after restoring the lost QA coverage IDs and documenting its operational ownership.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects steipete most directly to the proposed release-controller and continuation design, though final policy approval should come from the release-owner group.
